name: special_ndtri
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::special_ndtri(Tensor self) -> Tensor. Computes the inverse standard-normal cumulative distribution function elementwise without mutating or aliasing the input. The correctness suite covers all legacy pointwise shapes, float32 and supported float64 execution, probability boundaries and out-of-domain NaN behavior, noncontiguous tensors, and the NotImplementedError contract for float16 and bfloat16.
